scope: Frozen CPU + MAC + CoKANE digital block qualification, SKY130A, 5x4 tiles, 20 MHz
required: nine-corner setup/hold STA and electrical checks
excluded: full-chip power/IR/EM and foundry release signoff
note: Low predictive accuracy is separate from supported integer execution. Unsupported descriptors and malformed data must fail in a controlled way. Physical qualification does not certify every model or real hardware fault.
